column3: Saori's Strange Confession
Sa-Saori... Did you just say "marriage interview"?
Ha ha ha. No no, spare me, please.
It's not fair to press someone on a failed joke.
Don't try to dodge it! That didn't sound like a joke!
Ho ho! Can it be that Kyousuke-shi...
Gets jealous of a girl when she is about to get married?
That's not it!
...Never mind, I can't do anything if you don't want to talk about it.
Well, let us change the topic.
Oh? Kyousuke-shi? What's with the staring?
...I just can't leave it at that. It bothers me.
Well, even if it's a marriage interview, it's not such a big deal.
So you ARE going?! To a marriage interview!
It's something that everyone goes through once. You have done it before, right?
No, I haven't!
Ooh, a sharp retort as usual. I am grateful!
Marriage interview? Me?
Kyousuke-shi... Why are you hesitating...
That was such a splendid opportunity for a retort...
...What are the two of you whispering about?
No, no, it's nothing. We're having a heated debate over the rapid-firing performance of machine-pistols.
I said! Don't try to dodge it like that!
Kyousuke-shi. You're intruding into a woman's private affairs...
B-But, this bothers me!
This discussion ends here.
Oh...
Machine-pistols?
Seems like Kyousuke-shi's level is rather high!
However, a speechless Kyousuke-shi is quite moe.
B-Be quiet!
However, rest assured...
Eh?
Nothing about me will change. And...
My relationship with you also won't change.
So you ARE going to a marriage interview!
Hahaha, that's right!
However, this is a common occurrence. I'll take care of it quickly.
She's indeed going to a marriage interview...
Seems like she doesn't want to get questioned about it...
...So, what shall be our next destination?
Anyway, rest assured, it's nothing.
She doesn't look like she wants me prying into it though...
It-It's true... I'm not lying.
Got it.
B-But, where should we go next?
